AWS deployment¶

Cloud data flow¶

S3 raw
   |
   v
AWS Glue Spark
   |
   +--> vehicle_efficiency/
   +--> model_efficiency/
   +--> region_efficiency/
   +--> range_trend/
   |
   v
Glue Crawler / Data Catalog
   |
   v
Athena
   |
   v
FastAPI / Dashboard

S3 layout¶

A recommended object layout is:

s3://<bucket>/
  raw/
    vehicles/
      dataset.csv
  curated/
    vehicle_efficiency/
    model_efficiency/
    region_efficiency/
    range_trend/
    top_vehicles/
    bottom_vehicles/
  athena-results/

Glue job¶

The complete AWS Glue source is included below.

  1"""AWS Glue Spark job for the production analytics pipeline.
  2
  3Inputs
  4------
  5input_path:
  6    S3 URI containing the raw telemetry CSV.
  7output_path:
  8    S3 URI under which curated Parquet datasets are written.
  9
 10The job cleans telemetry, calculates battery consumption and estimated
 11range, aggregates vehicle/model/region metrics, and writes analytics
 12datasets for the Glue Catalog and Athena.
 13"""
 14
 15# AWS Glue 4.0/5.0 Spark job
 16# Job parameters:
 17# --input_path s3://YOUR-BUCKET/raw/vehicles/dataset.csv
 18# --output_path s3://YOUR-BUCKET/curated
 19
 20import sys
 21from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
 22from awsglue.context import GlueContext
 23from pyspark.context import SparkContext
 24from pyspark.sql import functions as F
 25from pyspark.sql.window import Window
 26
 27args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ["input_path","output_path"])
 28
 29sc = SparkContext()
 30glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
 31spark = glueContext.spark_session
 32
 33df = (
 34    spark.read.option("header",True)
 35    .option("inferSchema",True)
 36    .csv(args["input_path"])
 37)
 38
 39df = df.dropna(subset=[
 40    "vehicle_id","model","region","timestamp",
 41    "speed_kmh","battery_percent","distance_km"
 42])
 43
 44df = df.filter(
 45    (F.col("speed_kmh") >= 0) &
 46    (F.col("distance_km") > 0) &
 47    F.col("battery_percent").between(0,100)
 48)
 49
 50w = Window.partitionBy("vehicle_id").orderBy("timestamp")
 51
 52df = df.withColumn(
 53    "previous_battery",
 54    F.lag("battery_percent").over(w)
 55)
 56
 57df = df.withColumn(
 58    "battery_consumed",
 59    F.col("previous_battery") - F.col("battery_percent")
 60)
 61
 62df = df.withColumn(
 63    "event_efficiency",
 64    F.when(
 65        F.col("battery_consumed") > 0,
 66        F.col("distance_km") / F.col("battery_consumed")
 67    )
 68)
 69
 70df = df.withColumn(
 71    "estimated_range_km",
 72    F.when(
 73        F.col("event_efficiency") > 0,
 74        F.col("battery_percent") * F.col("event_efficiency")
 75    )
 76)
 77
 78vehicle = (
 79    df.groupBy("vehicle_id","model","region")
 80      .agg(
 81          F.sum("distance_km").alias("total_distance_km"),
 82          F.sum(
 83              F.when(F.col("battery_consumed") > 0,
 84                     F.col("battery_consumed")).otherwise(0)
 85          ).alias("total_battery_consumed"),
 86          F.avg("speed_kmh").alias("avg_speed_kmh"),
 87          F.avg("temperature_c").alias("avg_temperature_c"),
 88          F.avg("estimated_range_km").alias("avg_estimated_range_km")
 89      )
 90      .withColumn(
 91          "overall_efficiency",
 92          F.col("total_distance_km") /
 93          F.col("total_battery_consumed")
 94      )
 95)
 96
 97model = (
 98    vehicle.groupBy("model")
 99    .agg(
100        F.sum("total_distance_km").alias("total_distance_km"),
101        F.sum("total_battery_consumed").alias("total_battery_consumed")
102    )
103    .withColumn(
104        "overall_efficiency",
105        F.col("total_distance_km") /
106        F.col("total_battery_consumed")
107    )
108)
109
110region = (
111    vehicle.groupBy("region")
112    .agg(
113        F.sum("total_distance_km").alias("total_distance_km"),
114        F.sum("total_battery_consumed").alias("total_battery_consumed")
115    )
116    .withColumn(
117        "overall_efficiency",
118        F.col("total_distance_km") /
119        F.col("total_battery_consumed")
120    )
121)
122
123trend = (
124    df.withColumn("date", F.to_date("timestamp"))
125    .groupBy("date")
126    .agg(
127        F.avg("estimated_range_km").alias("avg_estimated_range_km"),
128        F.avg("battery_percent").alias("avg_battery_percent")
129    )
130)
131
132vehicle.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(args["output_path"]+"/vehicle_efficiency/")
133model.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(args["output_path"]+"/model_efficiency/")
134region.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(args["output_path"]+"/region_efficiency/")
135trend.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(args["output_path"]+"/range_trend/")

Terraform¶

The infrastructure definitions are included directly from the repository.

 1terraform {
 2  required_version = ">= 1.6.0"
 3
 4  required_providers {
 5    aws = {
 6      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
 7      version = "~> 6.0"
 8    }
 9  }
10}
11
12provider "aws" {
13  region = var.aws_region
14}
15
16resource "aws_s3_bucket" "ev_analytics" {
17  bucket = var.bucket_name
18
19  tags = {
20    Project = "EV Range Analytics"
21  }
22}
23
24resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "ev_analytics" {
25  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.ev_analytics.id
26
27  versioning_configuration {
28    status = "Enabled"
29  }
30}
31
32resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "ev_analytics" {
33  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.ev_analytics.id
34
35  rule {
36    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
37      sse_algorithm = "AES256"
38    }
39  }
40}
41
42resource "aws_glue_catalog_database" "ev" {
43  name = var.glue_database_name
44}

 1variable "aws_region" {
 2  type    = string
 3  default = "ap-south-1"
 4}
 5
 6variable "bucket_name" {
 7  type = string
 8}
 9
10variable "glue_database_name" {
11  type    = string
12  default = "ev_range_analytics"
13}

1output "bucket_name" {
2  value = aws_s3_bucket.ev_analytics.bucket
3}
4
5output "glue_database" {
6  value = aws_glue_catalog_database.ev.name
7}

1aws_region = "ap-south-1"
2bucket_name = "REPLACE-WITH-YOUR-GLOBALLY-UNIQUE-BUCKET"
3glue_database_name = "ev_range_analytics"

AWS notes¶

  • Ensure the S3 bucket and Athena query-results location are in the same AWS region.

  • The Glue crawler should target the curated Parquet prefix.

  • The Glue service role needs the required S3 and Glue permissions.

  • Do not place AWS access keys directly in source code.
